recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, waist-up portrait of a bearded man in a denim jacket, blended via double exposure with a snow-capped mountain range and pine forest. The composition is set against a textured, off-white paper background with a warm, faded color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: The mountain peaks align with the subject's shoulders and chest, creating a structural fusion.
The pine tree silhouettes form the jagged bottom edge of the subject's torso.
The warm skin tones contrast with the cool blue and white of the mountain snow.
coreInvariants: Double exposure blending mode (Lighten or Screen)
Jagged, organic bottom border made of tree silhouettes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, occupying the top two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, looking slightly off-camera to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the face down through the mountain texture to the bold typography at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample breathing room on all sides, emphasizing the isolated silhouette.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Desaturated, low-contrast vintage feel with high-key background.

letterConstructionRules: Integration of graphic symbols into glyphs (e.g., mountain peak in the 'O')
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' is replaced or modified with a triangular mountain silhouette.

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the base of the composition

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same family or color, varying weight and tracking for hierarchy.

preserve: Wide tracking for the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight for the display title.
Clean geometric lines that allow for easy modification of the 'O'.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with a beard in a denim jacket, using a double exposure effect to blend his torso with a snowy mountain range and a base of pine tree silhouettes. Set against a high-key, textured cream paper background. Mute the colors to a vintage film look.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, geometric sans-serif uppercase text in terracotta orange at the bottom. The main title should have tight kerning and a mountain icon integrated into one letter. The secondary text below should be smaller with very wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the bottom edge of the person defined by tree silhouettes?
Is the mountain texture visible through the jacket and face?
Is the background a textured off-white rather than pure white?

adjustableVariables: Typography color (e.g., switching to forest green or navy)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of the two exposures

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the double exposure doesn't obscure the eyes too much.
Check that the tree silhouettes at the bottom feel organic and not repetitive.
Verify the typography is perfectly centered.
Confirm the paper texture is visible across the entire frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject Silhouette] + [Nature Landscape] via [Double Exposure] on [Textured Paper Background] with [Bold Geometric Typography] at the base.
